text: RESULTS: Toxicology_Screen: Amphetamines Positive, Cocaine Negative, Opiates Negative, Benzodiazepines Negative, Cannabinoids Negative; Chemistry_Panel: Sodium Normal, Potassium Normal, Creatinine Normal, Blood_Glucose Normal
